en: Recto of an old German-language postal card labeled "Postkarte" with handwritten address information. On the left is the sender address written in black ink, on the right the addressee in the city of Reval with reference to the "Teater Estonia". There is an orange postage stamp from "Deutsches Reich" overprinted "Postgebiet Ob. Ost" and cancelled at Hapsal. A purple circular registration mark with a large "R" is also present. The card is tan with a central vertical divider line.
